messages:
product-lead: Quick heads-up: Hosted Mosaic-Lite (low-latency) is GA effective now. This adds `mosaic-lite-v1` and the new `/v2/stream-lowlatency` endpoint optimized for sub-100ms tail in common mobile/edge patterns. Internal docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/mosaic-lite (internal).

product-lead: Short bullets: 1) Model: mosaic-lite-v1 (fast attention + compact KV). 2) Endpoint: /v2/stream-lowlatency supports token streaming + optional final embed. 3) SDKs (py/js) minor bump to expose `streamLowLatency` helper. 4) Pricing: same per-token with optional low-latency premium; early-adopter credits for first 30 days. 5) Deprecation: legacy /v1/real-time will be deprecated in 45 days; 30-day auto-forwarding available.

cto: Huge congrats team :tada:. This is a strategic perf win for product integrations.

devx: Migration example (python) - minimal change:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)
for event in client.stream_lowlatency.open(model='mosaic-lite-v1', input='Summarize...'):
    if event['type']=='token':
        print(event['text'], end='')
    elif event['type']=='final':
        print('\n--done--')
```
No auth changes; most users only need to update the endpoint helper.

infra-deploy-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: start=2123461200, stages=5%->25%->60%->100% over ~6h. Rollback window=90m. Canary keys in secrets/mosaic-lite/canary/*. Watch signals: ll-tail-p95, stream-drop-rate, kv-cache-hit.

sre-oncall: Observability: new Console -> Models -> mosaic-lite-v1 dashboard (p50/p95/p99, stream-drop-rate, cache-hit-rate). Alerts: mosaic-lite-p95-high, stream-drop-spike. Oncall tagged for first 48h.

sales-eng: Pricing question - how do we communicate premium?

product-lead: We'll push pricing copy to Console tomorrow; early-adopter premium waived for 30 days. Sales collateral to follow in #marketing.

privacy: Note: low-latency mode reduces prefix capture by default; retention unchanged (30 days) unless account-level setting. For dedicated/private ask privacy for exceptions.

devx: Deprecation timeline: exact cutover ts=2123435789 + 45 days -> cutover_ts=212... (will post exact epoch in Console banner). SDKs will warn 14 days prior. If any partner needs longer, open an integration ticket.

product-lead: Launch readout + ops runbook walkthrough today 15:00 PT in #release-war-room. Runbook, rollback checklist, and quick-test scripts attached there. Thanks to infra/devx/sre/marketing for pushing this over the line :rocket:
